message:
docs(field): 0.2.100 field test 14:13-14:36 -- relayed path, UAC click scale error root-caused, log-upload 401 observability gap

Host-side and directory-server evidence only: the NAS has no host/viewer/client lines for the
window because the host app's uploader kept a rotated host token (401 since 13:48:39, batches
discarded) and the 13:56 directory restart dropped the in-memory client sessions. Viewer-side
metrics (NACK negotiation/effect, keyResync, keyRetries, present gaps, control RTT) are
therefore unverified, and the relay's share of the ~100 ms feel cannot be estimated.

- Every session ran through the relay (journal bound/active; host 'endpoint translated' to
  the NAS); no P2P bind on the new router.
- Host send path healthy; zero loss/congestion keyframe requests reached the host in 25 min;
  reason=7 recovery-timer requests 1-2 per reconnect, bounded.
- UAC clicks: position-proportional scale error (x1.165, y1.141) -- the host hands the secure
  input agent a target rect read once at process start (2236x1232, the RDP-era virtual display)
  and never refreshes it; the agent's live virtual screen is 1920x1080. New plan item P9.
- After the first WGC use d3d-mt flips off->on and readback D3D calls cost 6-8 ms while the
  DXGI acquire loop runs (94 us during WGC window capture) -- consistent with the acquire-lock
  hypothesis, not proven.
- Log upload 401 after re-registration: new plan item P10.
